description: This file defines the PackageManagerComm class, which provides static and instance methods for interacting with a remote package depot using SOAP. It includes methods for initialization, login, logout, fetching categories, packages, releases, downloads, documentation, and updates, as well as error checking and session management.

classes.name: PackageManagerComm
classes.description: Class providing methods to communicate with a package depot via SOAP, including login, download, and update check functionalities.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up the SOAP client and optionally logs in.

methods.name: errorCheck
methods.description: Checks for errors in the SOAP response.

methods.name: setCredentials
methods.description: Stores user credentials in session variables.

methods.name: clearSession
methods.description: Clears the session ID for re-authentication.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Logs into the depot service, establishing a session.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Logs out of the depot service.

methods.name: getCategoryPackages
methods.description: Retrieves categories and packages under a specific category.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves child categories of a given category.

methods.name: getPackages
methods.description: Retrieves packages under a specific category.

methods.name: getReleases
methods.description: Retrieves releases for a specific package.

methods.name: addDownload
methods.description: Adds a download to the queue and returns the filename.

methods.name: performDownload
methods.description: Performs the actual download using cURL via PackageManagerDownloader.

methods.name: getDocumentation
methods.description: Retrieves documentation for a package or release.

methods.name: downloadedDocumentation
methods.description: Logs that documentation has been downloaded.

methods.name: checkForUpdates
methods.description: Checks for available updates for objects.
